newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Swedish May unemployment seen 7.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Swedish May unemployment seen 7.9 pct.

text.p: Swedish unemployment is expected to fall to 7.9 percent in May from 8.3 percent in April, a Reuters poll of 14 analysts showed.
Forecasts ranged from 7.7 percent to 8.2 percent. In May 1996 unemployment was 7.1 percent.
For full-year 1997 unemployment is expected to be 8.1 percent, the poll showed. Full-year forecasts ranged from 7.3 percent to 8.4 percent.
Statistics Sweden is due to announce the figure at 1100 GMT on June 6.

Sources who participated in the survey were from: Aragon, Carnegie, Chase, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, J P Morgan, Lehman Brothers, Nomura, Nordbanken , Sparbanken, Unibank and Ohman.
Those who gave no full year forecast were: Chase, Consensus, Lehman Brothers.
